about: Every shared Street Kit asset. Re-download a source with SpriteCook get_asset_metadata(asset_id).sprite_url. used_by lists the games that use each output.

assets.name: kerb_granite
assets.label: Granite kerb section, side-on, seamless left to right
assets.prompt: A straight section of British granite kerb stones seen side-on from a slightly elevated camera about 20 degrees down: a thin strip of paving slabs on top, the pale kerb stones with a crisp bright sunlit highlight running along the kerb's rounded top front edge, the kerb's vertical front face in soft shade, and a narrow strip of dark tarmac gutter at the bottom. Runs straight across the whole frame, horizontal, no objects, no people.
assets.style: flat gouache picture-book illustration matching the style reference: soft-edged flat colour fills with visible brush texture, warm low golden-hour sunlight from the upper left with an apricot rim light, one long soft painted shadow falling to the lower right, no black outlines
assets.notes: Seamless horizontal strip: the source with its rounded ends cut off and the seam cross-faded. Its highlight sits just under the top edge, so Kerby draws its own thin hit-zone line on top.

assets.name: house_semi
assets.label: Red-brick 1930s semi, front elevation (one half)
assets.prompt: The front of one red-brick 1930s British semi-detached house seen straight-on from the street, flat front elevation, side-on, not angled: hipped grey slate roof with a chimney, white UPVC bay window with net curtains downstairs, a window upstairs with pebble-dash panel, white UPVC porch and front door, a satellite dish on the wall. Only this one house, no ground, no garden, no people.
assets.style: flat gouache picture-book illustration matching the style reference: soft-edged flat colour fills with visible brush texture, warm low golden-hour sunlight from the upper left with an apricot rim light, one long soft painted shadow falling to the lower right, no black outlines
assets.notes: One half of a pair with its own hipped roof; mirroring it for the other half leaves a notch between the roofs. A true pair would need a new generation.

assets.name: far_roofs
assets.label: Distant suburban roofline silhouette, seamless left to right
assets.prompt: A long row of distant British suburban rooftops seen from far away: pitched roofs, chimney stacks with pots, TV aerials, a satellite dish and a few rounded tree crowns, painted as one flat soft silhouette band in muted dusky mauve with only very faint lighter edges where the low sun catches the roof ridges, no windows, no detail, no outlines. Front elevation, a straight horizontal strip filling the width, ends cut square, flat bottom edge. No ground, no sky, no cast shadow.
assets.style: flat gouache picture-book illustration matching the style reference: soft-edged flat colour fills with visible brush texture, one painted shadow shape on the right, warm apricot golden-hour light from a low sun on the left, no black outlines
assets.notes: Flat muted-mauve silhouette with faint warm ridge highlights; fill below it with its own bottom-edge colour. Kerby uses it on the sky parallax layer; Tip the Can could use it in its sky band or title screen, graded to dusk.

assets.name: car_escort
assets.label: Escort look-alike hatchback, side elevation facing right
assets.prompt: One 1990s British family hatchback car, a generic Ford Escort look-alike with no badges, seen exactly side-on facing right: faded cherry-red paint, black plastic bumpers and trims, grey hubcaps, windows showing a hint of the empty seats inside, no driver, no number plate, no text, no lettering anywhere. Side elevation, seen straight-on from the pavement, flat, not angled. Only this car, no ground, no road, no people, no cast shadow, transparent background.
assets.style: flat gouache picture-book illustration matching the style reference: soft-edged flat colour fills with visible brush texture, one painted shadow shape on the right, warm apricot golden-hour light from a low sun on the left, no black outlines
assets.notes: Side elevation for a car crossing the road side-on (Kerby's CAR!). Muted 12% in processing to stay under Kerby's saturation budget. Tip the Can would need its own top view of a car; this one suits side-on games and title art.

assets.name: kerb_concrete
assets.label: Concrete kerb section, side-on, seamless left to right
assets.prompt: The same straight section of kerb as the reference image, same layout and proportions (a thin strip of paving slabs on top, the kerb, a narrow strip of dark tarmac gutter at the bottom), but made of British precast concrete kerb units instead of granite: smoother, paler, even grey-cream concrete with thin straight joints between short units, a softer more rounded top front edge with a gentler highlight along it, the vertical front face in soft shade. Runs straight across the whole frame, horizontal, ends cut square, no objects, no people.
assets.style: flat gouache picture-book illustration matching the style reference: soft-edged flat colour fills with visible brush texture, one painted shadow shape on the right, warm apricot golden-hour light from a low sun on the left, no black outlines
assets.notes: An edit of kerb_granite with the same layout: in Kerby's 512 px strip the arris is at row 64 and the face foot at row 125 (granite: 66 and 129). Paler, softer top edge.

assets.name: kerb_dropped
assets.label: Dropped kerb at a driveway, side-on, seamless left to right
assets.prompt: The same straight section of kerb as the reference image, same layout, but a British dropped kerb at a driveway: the kerb stones are lowered almost flush with the road so only a very low sliver of front face shows, the paving slabs slope gently down to it, a faint highlight along the low top edge, a narrow strip of dark tarmac gutter at the bottom. Runs straight across the whole frame, horizontal, ends cut square, no ramps at the ends, no objects, no people.
assets.style: flat gouache picture-book illustration matching the style reference: soft-edged flat colour fills with visible brush texture, one painted shadow shape on the right, warm apricot golden-hour light from a low sun on the left, no black outlines
assets.notes: An edit of kerb_granite: the kerb lowered almost flush with the road, for driveway dead zones. No ramps at the ends, so it tiles; add ramps in code if a game needs them.

assets.name: bangers_font
assets.label: Bangers, a comic display face (SIL OFL 1.1)
assets.notes: Free font, not generated. Kerby uses it for CLACK!, CAR! and the title logo. Keep the OFL text next to the font.
